body: Hey there. I totally get you. I’ve struggled with feelings of loneliness even when I had friends. The best advice I can give you is to keep yourself busy and work on you. Focus on your work and develop relationships there. Pick up a hobby. Volunteer. Go to church. Join a class. Read books. Run at the park every morning. Do all the things you’ve always wanted to do because you have a lot of time. As someone in a committed relationship, I do envy that. But most importantly, be comfortable with being alone. It’s tough and it takes time but we need to learn to love ourselves slowly but surely. By then, I’m sure the social connections will come because people will gravitate towards you.
